decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - A sample of the glazing to be utilised in the development hereby permitted, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. The window frames shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewithDrawing Numbers  2PH1, 2PH2, 2PH3, 2PH4, 2PH5, 2PH6, 2PH7, 2PH8, 2PH9, 2PH10, 2PH11, 2PH12, 2PH13, 2PH14, 2PH15, Design and Access Statement received 23/05/12 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Listed building consent for the erection of conservatory enclosing part of lower courtyard to existing maisonette
